   I don't get why. NEAR Intents already does machine-to-machine payments without any of it. The agent says what it wants, solvers settle it, cross-chain and confidential. No contract to deploy, nothing to audit, no gas token to keep topped up on five chains.  
   And with no contract, there is no contract engineering. Idea to working agent is one prompt: you describe what it should do, it reads the API, it trades or pays. I have one running like this. It trades a real on-chain portfolio, it can never withdraw from it, and none of it needed a line of Solidity.
